title: Gitmap spot colour record (one line of spot-colors.ndjson)
description: A print separation (named ink). Not a palette colour: no symbol draws in one, it has no stacking position, and OCAD and Mapper disagree on whether a separation also appears in the palette.

name.description: Separation name; its identity. Unique within the file.

rgb.description: Screen colour as an [r, g, b] integer triple (0..255), the same shape as a palette colour's rgb.
